newsitem.title: USA: Acceptance Insurance expands crop coverage.
newsitem.headline: Acceptance Insurance expands crop coverage.

text.p: Acceptance Insurance Cos Inc said Wednesday it won approval from the Federal Crop Insurance Corp to expand Crop Revenue Coverage (CRC) to 11 more states for 1997 corn and soybean crops.
The program protects farmers against lost revenue caused by low prices or low yields, Acceptance Insurance said.
The new states are Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Dakota and Texas. The company previously offered the policies in Nebraska and Iowa.
Acceptance Insurance is a property and casualty insurance company. Its shares were trading up 1/4 Wdnesday at 20.
